tracesTo: UserFlow: League Access, Switching & Role-Based Experience

stories.title: Pin Moments to Top of Feed
stories.goal: pin important moments to the top of the feed so they remain visible to all members
stories.benefit: critical announcements and featured content stay prominent regardless of new activity
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select any moment in feed and choose 'Pin to Top' action
Pinned moments appear above all other content in feed with visual indicator showing pinned status
Multiple moments can be pinned simultaneously with clear ordering control
Admin can unpin moments to return them to normal feed position based on timestamp/engagement
Pinned status persists across all user sessions and devices

stories.title: Hide Problematic Content from Feed
stories.goal: temporarily hide inappropriate or problematic moments from the feed without permanent deletion
stories.benefit: I can quickly moderate content while preserving it for review or potential restoration
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select any moment and choose 'Hide from Feed' moderation action
Hidden moments are immediately removed from public feed view for all members
Hidden content remains accessible to admins through dedicated moderation queue
Admin can unhide moments to restore them to feed at their original position
System logs hide/unhide actions with admin user and timestamp for audit trail

stories.title: Permanently Delete Inappropriate Content
stories.goal: permanently remove content that violates league standards or community guidelines
stories.benefit: I can maintain feed quality and remove content that should not be preserved
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select hidden moments and choose 'Delete Permanently' action with confirmation prompt
Deleted moments are removed from database and cannot be recovered
All associated comments and reactions are also deleted with the parent moment
System logs deletion action with admin user, timestamp, and optional reason note
Deletion action includes confirmation dialog warning admin of permanent nature

stories.title: View Moderation Queue of Hidden Content
stories.goal: access a dedicated interface showing all currently hidden moments for review and management
stories.benefit: I can review moderated content, track moderation history, and make informed decisions about restoration or deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Admin menu includes 'Moderation Queue' link accessible only to admin role
Moderation queue displays all hidden moments with reason for hiding and admin who performed action
Queue interface shows moment preview, hide timestamp, and quick actions for unhide or delete
Admins can filter queue by content type, date range, or moderating admin
Queue displays empty state with helpful message when no content is currently hidden

stories.title: Set Pin Priority Order for Multiple Pinned Moments
stories.goal: control the display order of multiple pinned moments at top of feed
stories.benefit: I can ensure the most important announcement appears first among pinned content
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access pin management interface showing all currently pinned moments
Interface provides drag-and-drop or numbered ordering to set pin priority
Changes to pin order take effect immediately for all users viewing the feed
System enforces reasonable limit on total pinned moments (e.g., maximum 5 pinned at once)
Pin order persists across sessions and is consistent for all league members

stories.title: Access Moderation Actions from Feed Interface
stories.goal: perform moderation actions directly from feed without navigating to separate admin panel
stories.benefit: I can quickly moderate content as I browse the feed during normal league engagement
acceptanceCriteria: Each moment card displays admin-only moderation menu icon when viewed by admin user
Moderation menu includes options: Pin/Unpin, Hide, and Delete (for hidden content)
Actions execute with inline confirmation and immediate visual feedback
Non-admin users do not see moderation controls or menu options
Moderation menu adapts based on current moment state (e.g., shows 'Unpin' for pinned moments)
